title: A launcher run that aborts at registration before any test starts is recorded as a FAILED test verification
outcome: When the test launcher aborts before any test starts (for example a registration POST that exceeds its budget, so nothing compiles or runs), the host records no failed test verification for the item, or records a distinct not-run/infrastructure disposition that an evaluator cannot read as a test failure at that revision.
acceptance: A recognised launcher check (`node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full|focused|live`) that exits non-zero while its output shows no sign that the run executed — neither a launcher verdict line `PASS|FAIL <runId> exit=<code>` nor a launcher stage line `NAME: passed|failed` — ends with outcome Unknown, never Failed, in both the one-call form and the plain (cwd-reporting) form; output whose only launcher lines are `FAIL launcher: …` refusals is such a run. A fail-first unit test feeds the exact output of run test-7f571048 (the RUN line and the `FAIL launcher: registration error … no tests started` line) with exit 1, and shows Failed on unchanged code and Unknown with the fix.

A run that did execute is still classified as today. A launcher output with `FAIL <runId> exit=1` and a `rust-tests: failed` stage line ends Failed, and `PASS <runId> exit=0` with a passed test stage still earns a passed verification. Existing check-recognition, focused-run and carried-gate tests pass unchanged, and a new test pins the failed-verdict case.

A launcher run whose own results.json, found through its `results:` line, records every stage "unrun" ends Unknown, not Failed, even when its summary prints `FAIL <runId> exit=1`. Examples are the disk-capacity refusal that "saves a failed run with every stage unrun" (docs/test.md) and a registration refusal recorded after the summary line. A test covers it with a fixture run directory.
The maintained full five-stage gate passes on the exact final input, and the independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary:
A test-launcher check that ran no test stage is no longer recorded as a failed test. A launcher that exits non-zero without the run's verdict or a stage line (a refusal before its run starts, such as an aborted registration printing only `FAIL launcher: …`) now ends Unknown, in the one-call and plain forms. A foreground run whose own results.json, named by its `results:` line and matching its first verdict's run, records it failed with every stage unrun also ends Unknown. A carried gate like that is refused rather than recorded failed. A run that failed at any stage is still recorded failed. docs/test.md describes the rule.
